mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course ( title, description, category, teacher_id, status ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{teacherId}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT course_id, title, description, category, teacher_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.course_id, c.title, c.description, c.category, c.teacher_id, a.full_name AS teacher_name, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM course c LEFT JOIN account a ON c.teacher_id = a.account_id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.course_id, c.title, c.category, c.teacher_id, a.full_name AS teacher_name, c.status, c.created_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_enrollment ce WHERE ce.course_id = c.course_id AND ce.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS student_count, 0 AS joined FROM course c LEFT JOIN account a ON c.teacher_id = a.account_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.category = #{category}
AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.course_id, c.title, c.category, c.teacher_id, a.full_name AS teacher_name, c.status, c.created_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_enrollment ce_count WHERE ce_count.course_id = c.course_id AND ce_count.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS student_count, CASE WHEN ce.enrollment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS joined FROM course c LEFT JOIN account a ON c.teacher_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN course_enrollment ce ON ce.course_id = c.course_id AND ce.student_id = #{studentId} AND ce.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.category = #{category}
AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT course_id, title, description, category, teacher_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM course WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
